name: Universal Substitution Property
statement: A nonempty test $T\subseteq\{0,1\}^Y$ belongs to $\mathcal U_Y$ when, for every nonempty $C\in\mathsf{MaxMin}$ with a distinguished coordinate $i$ disjoint from $Y$, the nonempty substitution $(C[i=0]\times T)\cup(C[i=1]\times T^{\mathrm c})$ belongs to $\mathsf{MaxMin}$.
hypotheses: Finite binary classes on pairwise disjoint coordinate sets; complements are taken in the fixed test cube.
